The '''''Tyrant''''' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Tormen]] in the beginning of the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Evlen]].
